design: Fit one nonnegative gain and one shared low-pass tau to two declared horizontal-lobe color pairs. These terminal color ranks were selected by plot order, not by largest measured peak.
D/E evaluation pairs and all remaining secondary pairs never enter optimizer. Published curves were previously inspected; evaluation means excluded from fit, not blind or previously unseen data.

Normalize each calcium trace and each dye driver by its own positive peak during 0-12 s. This is a shape comparison; target normalization uses each evaluation trace peak and cannot validate absolute amplitude.

Gate input history at ATP time zero. Solve piecewise-linear driver exactly. Nonnegative proxy rectifies sampled dye knots before interpolation; signed proxy is an algebraic control. Raw negative measurements remain retained.

For every assumption, compare an instantaneous gain-only control with a low-pass fit whose candidate set includes tau=0. Evaluate complete 40 paired traces for both models: 320 prediction slots total, with undefined normalization reported explicitly.

Graphical input bounds pass through the same fitted positive-gain filter and compare with calcium stroke bounds, all normalized by fixed central peaks. This conditional envelope omits parameter, biological and normalization uncertainty. It is not a confidence interval or physiological acceptance threshold.
A 0.1 s grid is interpolation, not independent source samples. No statistical p-values or likelihood confidence intervals. No default selection, network run or membrane/release interpretation.
normalization_failure_rule: Pairs without positive dye peak remain explicitly unscorable; never alter a calibration/evaluation pair silently. First-attempt failure and amendment retained in validation/apl-reporter-filter-initial.
